preciseKnowledgePointChecks.sourceOfTruth: Only frozen course package mappings: explicit knowledgePointId/unitId/sectionId/parent/sourceSha256/kind(core/exercise/navigation)/questionIds and any declared precise-location core attribution. No nearest-heading or same-unit inference.
preciseKnowledgePointChecks.caseSelectionAfterDataFreeze: Choose a declared core point with real questions, a same-unit point with at least one exclusive question, a unit-root/navigation position with no eligible attribution, and actual Q10/Q99 references. Freeze selected IDs and expected sets before running UI.
preciseKnowledgePointChecks.emptyAndUnitOnly: No learned point => cannot start self-assessment. A plain unit opening or unknown/navigation position cannot grant the whole unit or all its questions.
preciseKnowledgePointChecks.singlePoint: Visit one valid point => only that point learned; sibling remains unlearned; eligible self-assessment set is exact frozen relation after exclusion/deduplication. Reading the whole HTML must not imply all rendered points visited.
preciseKnowledgePointChecks.multipleEvidence: Opening one cited source location records only its explicitly declared core point; it cannot mark all locations or knowledge points of that question.
preciseKnowledgePointChecks.personalQuestions: Q10/Q99 remain browseable with method/excerpts and personal-evidence warning, but excluded from the self-assessment pool even when related point is learned.
preciseKnowledgePointChecks.statusSeparation: Learned/visited point state, question not_mastered/mastered self-report, unit-opening history and legacy origins are separate identities; no credential or chapter completion claim.
preciseKnowledgePointChecks.inputIdentityException: 37 sourceBindings require current equality. routeStages provenance.receivedSourceSha256 is historical received-client reference, not required equality after authorized frontend changes.
preciseKnowledgePointChecks.originalEvidenceRanges: 327 exact quote ranges checked separately; original reviewSourceRange retains old QA span, including declared 22 wider spans crossing later headings, and is not silently rewritten.

isolationMethod.ports: Reserve a currently unused QA-only loopback port at execution time (planned 4473; never user 4318). Secondary backend/fault ports only if necessary and owned by QA.
isolationMethod.database: Fresh temp dataDir, not actual .runtime; do not read production SQLite. Disable generation configuration in owned process; semantic retrieval remains actual locked local BGE.
isolationMethod.storageFixtures: After client contract freezes, create QA-only seed HTML in this history and serve it briefly at the exact unused QA origin. Its visible button declares writes of fabricated v1/v10/v12/corrupt-history fixtures and new v13 keys; click through official CUA. Stop owned seed server, then launch unchanged candidate on same origin so only fixture browser storage is exercised. Never clear/read/write another origin or real user records; seed values and expected exact strings separately frozen.
isolationMethod.candidateIntegrity: No fixture script is inserted into candidate HTML and no product file is modified by QA. Actual candidate UI runs its frozen bytes; any isolated VM checks labeled separately. Compare actual downloaded JSON/path bytes to frozen fixtures and new UI actions.
isolationMethod.controlledFaults: Use an explicitly labeled QA-only transport proxy if necessary for late-response/version-mismatch/service-unavailable cases: serve/forward candidate bytes unchanged, real BGE requests forwarded, selectively delay an actual response or inject declared stale/error contract data. No synthetic response counts as actual model inference; no browser hidden protocol/interception APIs.
isolationMethod.browser: Official CUA only. Keep app test tab background. Read-only DOM evaluation for geometry/visible semantics only; do not read localStorage or other hidden state through evaluate. Actual fixture, notes, marks, exports, routes and settings manipulated through visible UI.
isolationMethod.proof: Capture real DOM/action observations and screenshots; actual download event/path supported by official CUA. If any necessary screenshot/file/export/fault action is unavailable, disclose exact limitation, do not substitute VM or author evidence.
isolationMethod.cleanup: Reset official temporary viewport; close QA-created temporary tabs; SIGINT all owned seed/candidate/proxy/backend processes, record exit and no listener. User 4318 remains untouched.

releaseConditionsBeforeExecution: Course JSON/MD/source-check/binding identities received. Full independent 114-title/327-quote/mapping check runs only after stable candidate, not author-check inheritance.
Explicit stable frontend candidate handoff with file identities, new route/storage contracts and author self-check.
No concurrent writes to submitted candidate during independent execution; first failed outputs preserved before repair.
Product/design/main clarification hashes still match and original 900-file baseline unchanged.
